crossRefs.note: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose…

translations.web: He took them, and ate in front of them.
translations.bsb: and He took it and ate it in front of them.
translations.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.
translations.asv: And he took it, and ate before them.
